<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{
  "body_md": "## Problem
Claims processing is delayed because bank details for third-party payees are not verified before payments are sent. This leads to bounced transactions, re-issuances, and disrupted timelines for policyholders and suppliers.

## Who is affected
- Six accounts have reported this issue [i:18f1007652dd0b9f][i:1a5ecfa9cdb48b37][i:38b720d2128e8410].
- The problem is reported across three routes: support, sales, and account management [i:61c8fd8956849053][i:9d538a27a5152cde][i:dd6d075cda456421].
- Accounts with a combined Annual Recurring Revenue of £4,210,000 are affected [i:ca6e7b08497a30d4][i:a5f23807d3046f88][i:c16ad7da45c8fcad].

## Evidence
- Pendleford Motor Mutual states they are seeing delays in claims payments because they can’t verify third-party bank details ahead of time [i:18f1007652dd0b9f]. They also note that payee account verification would prevent delays impacting their reserves and supplier reporting [i:a2b4cc8c23037ff7].
- Ravensgill Insurance reports they cannot validate third-party bank details before sending payments, causing bounces and reissuance days later [i:64666e73337f1420]. They have struggled with payment detail checking causing delays [i:6c5c7c3c767101ec].
- Holloway Reach Underwriting has a recurring issue with third-party payee account verification causing delays [i:38b720d2128e8410]. They note the verification step is not happening before payment dispatch, causing rework and client frustration [i:a16c8653e17d2f9e].
- Brantwick Commercial mentions they can’t verify bank details ahead of time, which causes bounces [i:45ff7920744f0d58]. They state bounced payments mean reissuing them days later, which messes up reserves and reporting [i:9bd19c6494c50ad9].
- Marrowgate Commercial notes that payee account verification isn’t happening before funds are released, causing unnecessary re-issuance delays and affecting supplier timelines [i:61c8fd8956849053].
- Thistlecombe Mutual states they struggle because they can’t verify third-party payee bank details before sending payments, forcing reissuance of failed payments days later and delaying claims resolution [i:c16ad7da45c8fcad].
- There have been 18 total mentions of this problem [i:496167fb04fcad32][i:b22db1eba2c77307][i:c577d40e69671d51].
- One renewal has occurred in the last 90 days [i:9d538a27a5152cde].

## Why now
- The issue is actively disrupting current claims workflows, with multiple accounts reporting it across support, sales, and account management channels in recent months [i:a5f23807d3046f88][i:dd6d075cda456421].
- The problem directly impacts financial operations, with customers citing effects on reserves, supplier reporting, and policyholder satisfaction [i:9bd19c6494c50ad9][i:a2b4cc8c23037ff7][i:c16ad7da45c8fcad].
- With one renewal in the last 90 days and several key accounts (including Marrowgate Commercial with £1,600,000 ARR renewing on 2026-12-12) approaching renewal, the operational and financial impact of payment delays is a pressing concern [i:61c8fd8956849053].
",
  "citations": ["i:18f1007652dd0b9f", "i:1a5ecfa9cdb48b37", "i:38b720d2128e8410", "i:61c8fd8956849053", "i:9d538a27a5152cde", "i:dd6d075cda456421", "i:ca6e7b08497a30d4", "i:a5f23807d3046f88", "i:c16ad7da45c8fcad", "i:64666e73337f1420", "i:6c5c7c3c767101ec", "i:a16c8653e17d2f9e", "i:45ff7920744f0d58", "i:9bd19c6494c50ad9", "i:496167fb04fcad32", "i:b22db1eba2c77307", "i:c577d40e69671d51"]
}
